text: Source reading (round 3): Maya experts_mma_kernel keeps NVFP4 packed in global, 32-bit __ldg per lane, nibble decode via __byte_perm LUT in registers, one-block register prefetch, f16 m16n8k16 MMA (sm_80+), single token per call, grouped multi-token path is scalar FP32 (weight row decoded once, dotted with all tokens). NInfer: GGUF prefill uses ggml MMQ (moe_mul_mat_q, tile word (jt<<16)|expert, J in 16..128), its own Q4-Q8 prefill uses cp.async+BF16 mma (sm_80+), NVFP4 sm_120a only, fixed-point 2^-32 sums. Basalt: no prefill expert GEMM found (decode window GEMM dequant-in-registers + bf16 mma, counting-sort expert plan, L2 prefetch sm_90+). SGLang: SM120 FlashInfer NVFP4 grouped GEMM with token-count-dependent tile (tokens<=1536: swap_ab, tile_n 32, tile_k 256), Triton BF16 fallback block_m 16/128, per-expert row padding to 128 for scale blocks. Nothing portable to sm_75 beyond what MMQ already does.

Not transferable as is: index-derived distance (rings), F16/F32 KV only (no Q8), not bit-exact, no GQA-3/vec decode.
